```artifact
Feature: Manage Medical Professionals and Laboratory Staff

  As an administrator, I want to manage medical professionals and laboratory staff so that I can maintain a high-quality healthcare service.

  Scenario: Adding a new doctor
  Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
  When I navigate to Add Doctors
  And I fill in the required information for a new doctor
  Then a new doctor should be added with a unique Doctor Id

  Examples:
    | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
    | Dr. Smith  | 45  | M  | MD           | 10 years   |
    | Dr. Jones | 38  | F  | PhD          | 5 years    |

  Scenario: Editing an existing doctor
  Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
  When I navigate to Edit/Update Doctors
  And I fill in the required information for an existing doctor
  Then the doctor's details should be updated

  Examples:
    | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
    | 12345     | Dr. Smith   | 45 | M  | MD           | 10 years   |
    | 67890     | Dr. Jones   | 38 | F  | PhD          | 5 years    |

  Scenario: Deleting a doctor
  Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
  When I navigate to Edit/Update Doctors
  And I select a doctor to delete
  Then the doctor's details should be deleted unless there are open consultation requests

  Examples:
    | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
    | 12345     | Dr. Smith   | 45 | M  | MD           | 10 years   |
    | 67890     | Dr. Jones   | 38 | F  | PhD          | 5 years    |

  Scenario: Adding a new chemist or lab
  Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
  When I navigate to Add Chemist/Labs
  And I fill in the required information for a new chemist or lab
  Then a new chemist or lab should be added with a unique Chemist/Lab Id

  Examples:
    | Chemist/Lab Name | Chemist Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
    | Chemist Smith | true            | 123 Main St.       | 555-1234       |
    | Lab Jones     | false           | 456 Main St.       | 555-4567       |

  Scenario: Editing an existing chemist or lab
  Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
  When I navigate to Add Chemist/Labs
  And I fill in the required information for an existing chemist or lab
  Then the chemist or lab's details should be updated

  Examples:
    | Chemist/Lab Id | Chemist Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
    | 12345     | Chemist Smith | true            | 123 Main St.       | 555-1234       |
    | 67890     | Chemist Jones | false           | 456 Main St.       | 555-4567       |

  Scenario: Deleting a chemist or lab
  Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
  When I navigate to Add Chemist/Labs
  And I select a chemist or lab to delete
  Then the chemist or lab's details should be deleted unless there are open consultation requests

  Examples:
    | Chemist/Lab Id | Chemist Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
    | 12345     | Chemist Smith | true            | 123 Main St.       | 555-1234       |
    | 67890     | Chemist Jones | false           | 456 Main St.       | 555-4567       |
```
